name: @factstack/ui-remix
description: Primary WebUI for FACTS. Built on Remix v3 (beta) — its own VDOM runtime, no React. Vite + JSX via @remix-run/ui's automatic runtime. Two build targets: dev server (live re-analyze) and static (Netlify deploy, `factstack export`, VS Code webview).

scripts.build: vite build && tsx scripts/inject-data.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs
scripts.build:static: vite build --mode static && tsx scripts/inject-data.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs
